card.name: Publisher names in book citations
card.fires_on: Parts of publisher names and the punctuation just before or inside them in bibliographic references, such as Longman, Springer Verlag, Barnes & Noble and Garnier frères.

modes.label: Inside publisher names
modes.description: Part of a publisher name, such as Long, Ver or ier, inside a book citation.
modes.example: Memoirs of Zehir-Ed-Din Muhammed Baber: emperor of Hindustan.<< Long>>man, Rees, Orme,

modes.label: Punctuation before publisher
modes.description: A comma, ampersand or period between place, author and publisher in a citation.

card.writes: It pushes toward the next piece of a publisher name, though the promoted tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on publisher names in old book references, like Longman or Springer Verlag.
